gen-press-start-2p-gf-nokora: Chunky retro fun, with Press Start 2P spacing its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart. But Nokora lays a thick, dark lowercase stripe through every line, its s never tightening.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P draws its horizontals a notch lighter than its uprights. Noto Sans Avestan brings a pronounced x-height and curve tips that never touch, a plain sans foil.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Cut-out letters set well apart, with only a faint swell where each bowl is widest, define Press Start 2P. Noto Sans Balinese keeps short ascenders and a breathing space inside every curve.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Press Start 2P brings retro fun, with mild thicks and big, open-looking lowercase bowls. And Noto Sans Bamum should glide through paragraph after paragraph, its curves stopping short of turning inward.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-batak: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart. It earns its keep big and brief, while Noto Sans Batak adds a towering x-height, plus an e that never looks squeezed.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Pixel-bright and playful, Press Start 2P shows a subtle weight change, like etched lines in glass. And Noto Sans Bengali should read smoothly, its capitals barely taller than lowercase and its letter mouths open.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Press Start 2P is retro fun, its letters spaced like cut-outs and its weight shifting as slightly as a stone-carved inscription. Noto Sans Chakma meets it with uncrowded, open mouths.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-cham: Cut-out spacing and gently modulated strokes with no harsh thin spots make Press Start 2P unmistakable. Noto Sans Cham sits beside it with tall, rounded lowercase and open entry space.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-ethiopic: Cut-out spacing, wide and loose, defines Press Start 2P, whose thin strokes still carry respectable weight. Noto Sans Ethiopic grounds it with a tall, sturdy lowercase, wide-hanging c terminals.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Fun and retro, Press Start 2P leads with thick strokes that guide the eye without dominating it. Noto Sans Georgian should read comfortably for a long while, its open apertures and short ascender stems keeping lines light.
